hook.text: Coding agents explain everything in walls of text. Mirador gives them a canvas, so they can show you.

showPoint.text: Architecture, flows, and mockups, right beside your chat. Point at anything they drew, and watch it update live.

ask.text: When it's your call, skip numbered lists — pick from real previews with a click.

review.text: Code reviews and tours walk you through changes in execution order, with findings pinned to exact lines, updated in place when you push back.

sideChat.text: Ask a quick side question without interrupting the turn, and inspect or commit every change right from the canvas.

media.text: Install official plugins on demand — like Media: mark what drags on the frame, and your agent cuts and renders the video.

delegate.text: Mirador runs the agents you already have — Claude Code, opencode, pi, Codex, Copilot, and Antigravity — and lets them delegate work to each other.

jobs.text: Long builds on another server? Mirador watches the job and wakes your agent the moment it finishes.

p2p.text: And now in Mirador zero point fifteen point five, connect your phone or another computer peer to peer — encrypted end to end, with nothing to configure.

end.text: See what your coding agent means.
